changelog: Fixed circular logic caused by rando'd starting recipes and the foundry.
Made the default cable recipe always be true as you always have it by default.
Changed the foundry's requirements to reflect the new ones implemented by the Archipelago mod.
Milestone and MAM Map phase/hub/node required recipes now have logic to check if you can make the stuff required to make those recipes.
Added detection for duplicate Satisfactory slots.
Added tracking for starting items! (mostly)
Added logging to the cmd line for multiple autotracking features.
Added some code for the hard drive map manual tracker.
Edited Milestone map logic to account for Global Vault, showing as yellow in map for obtainable with glitches.
Edited MAM Tech Tree logic to show nodes that are revealed when researching a higher node to be highlighted blue for viewable but not obtainable.
Edited AWESOME Shop logic to show nodes as blue if only the AWESOME Shop building bp as been obtained.
Edited Milestone map logic to have previous Elevator Phase requirements as logic rules for future phases.
Added Milestones map with locations and added logic to them.
Added automatic pack updating.
Populated AWESOME Store map with locations and added logic to them.
Populated all of the MAM Tech Tree maps with their respective location and added logic to all of them.
Re-added the starting recipes to the main item tracker.
Significantly reduced the file size by downscaling item and building images to 64x64 using .NET 8 / System.Drawing.Common.
Did general maintenance and improved a lot of code, getting stuff ready for future updates.
Fixed default names for Packaged Oil, Water, and Nitrogen Gas.
Initial release of Satisfactory PopTracker.
